title: DeepGroundRepair: From API-Grounded Generation to Shape-Aware Repair for Deep Learning Programs
title_zh: DeepGroundRepair：从基于API的生成到面向深度學習程式的形状感知修復

paragraphs.en: Deep learning (DL) programs are fundamental to modern AI applications, and automatically generating them from natural-language requirements can substantially reduce DL development effort. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated promising capabilities for this direction. However, generated DL programs often remain unreliable because they must satisfy domain-specific API usage constraints and tensor-shape dependencies, violations of which can cause API-level syntactic issues and runtime failures. Existing retrieval-augmented generation and feedback-guided code repair methods do not adequately address these DL-specific constraints.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose DeepGroundRepair , a three-stage framework that establishes a generation–localization–repair workflow to improve the reliability of LLM-generated DL programs. Its key idea is to progressively narrow the generation and repair spaces using DL-specific knowledge and runtime tensor information. Specifically, it grounds generation in task-relevant API knowledge, localizes the upstream causes of tensor-shape mismatch failures, and uses runtime tensor shapes to guide parameter repair. Together, these mechanisms transform open-ended generation and repair into a knowledge-grounded and shape-aware process.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 DeepGroundRepair——一个包含三个阶段的框架，通过建立“生成-定位-修复”的工作流程，提升 LLM 生成的深度学习程序的可靠性。 其核心思想是利用深度学习领域的特定知识和运行时张量信息，逐步缩小生成和修复的空间范围。 具体而言，该框架以任务相关的 API 知识为基础进行生成，定位导致张量形状不匹配故障的上游原因，并利用运行时张量形状指导参数修复。 这些机制共同将开放式的生成与修复过程，转化为一个基于知识且具备形状感知能力的流程。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate DeepGroundRepair on the 100 model-level DL programming tasks in DeepEval using six open-weight LLMs across TensorFlow, PyTorch, and PaddlePaddle. We compare it with four baselines: two generation-only methods and their counterparts incorporating traceback-guided self-debugging. The results show that, relative to these baselines, DeepGroundRepair reduces the combined number of API-level syntactic issues by an average of 5.4 per 10 program files and achieves an average relative improvement of 85.3% in code executability. Compared with the two self-debugging baselines, it improves semantic consistency by an average of 18.1% and reduces token cost by an average of 28.4%. The consistent improvements across model families, model scales, and DL libraries provide evidence of its generalizability within the evaluated scope.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 TensorFlow、PyTorch 和 PaddlePaddle 中的六种开源大语言模型（LLM），在 DeepEval 的 100 个模型级深度学习编程任务上对 DeepGroundRepair 进行了评估。 我们将它与四种基线方法进行了比较：两种仅生成代码的方法，以及它们结合回溯引导的自我调试版本。 结果表明，与这些基线方法相比，DeepGroundRepair 平均每 10 个程序文件减少了 5.4 个 API 级语法问题，并使代码可执行性平均提升了 85.3%。 与两种自我调试基线方法相比，它在语义一致性方面平均提升了 18.1%，同时使令牌成本平均降低了 28.4%。 该方法在不同模型系列、模型规模和深度学习库中表现出的持续改进，证明了其在评估范围内的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in generating code from natural language ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . By translating programming intent into executable code, LLMs can lower barriers to and reduce the effort required for software development. Yet, performance on general-purpose code generation does not necessarily extend to domain-specific programming tasks. This challenge is especially pronounced in DL programming, where structural and semantic dependencies make DL programs prone to bugs involving API usage and tensor compatibility ( Humbatova et al., 2020 ; Liang et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Therefore, improving the reliability of LLM-generated DL programs remains a challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，大型语言模型（LLM）在根据自然语言生成代码方面展现出强大的能力（Jiang 等，2026；Li 等，2025；Jiang 等，2025）。 通过将编程意图转化为可执行代码，LLM 能够降低软件开发的技术门槛并减少所需的工作量。 然而，通用代码生成方面的性能并不一定适用于特定领域的编程任务。 这一挑战在深度学习（DL）编程中尤为突出，因为结构性和语义上的依赖关系使得 DL 程序容易出现与 API 使用和张量兼容性相关的错误（Humbatova 等，2020；Liang 等，2022；Yang 等，2024）。 因此，提升 LLM 生成的 DL 程序的可靠性仍然是一项挑战。

paragraphs.en: In DL programs, DL models are constructed as computation graphs of interdependent API calls and tensor transformations. Program correctness therefore depends on library-specific API configurations and tensor compatibility across the graph. As demonstrated in our prior study ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , LLM-generated DL code frequently encounters two prevalent problems. Problem 1 : API-Level Syntactic Issues. LLMs frequently hallucinate or misuse DL APIs, including references to nonexistent members and violations of API signatures. Problem 2 : Runtime Execution Failures. LLM-generated DL code frequently fails at runtime due to violations of implicit constraints among DL operations. Among such failures, tensor - shape mismatches are the predominant type, accounting for 77.34% of execution failures on average ( Ma et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在深度学习（DL）程序中，DL 模型被构建为相互依赖的 API 调用和张量变换的计算图。 因此，程序的正确性取决于特定库的 API 配置以及整个计算图中的张量兼容性。 正如我们先前研究（Ma et al., 2026）所示，由大型语言模型（LLM）生成的 DL 代码经常遇到两个普遍问题。 问题 1：API 级别的语法问题。 LLM 经常对 DL API 产生幻觉或误用，包括引用不存在的成员以及违反 API 签名规范的情况。 问题 2：运行时执行失败。 由 LLM 生成的 DL 代码常因违反 DL 操作之间的隐式约束而在运行时失败。 在这些失败中，张量形状不匹配是最主要类型，平均占执行失败的 77.34%（Ma et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Existing studies relevant to these problems mainly follow two directions. One line of work employs retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to ground code generation in external knowledge ( Zhou et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Jain et al., 2025 ) . Its effectiveness, however, depends heavily on retrieving task-relevant context, as irrelevant information can introduce noise and degrade code generation ( Gu et al., 2025 ) . In DL programming, this challenge is further complicated by the gap between high-level task intent and fine-grained API requirements, making static query–document matching prone to retrieving irrelevant API knowledge ( Su et al., 2024 ) . Another line of work investigates feedback-guided code repair, in which failure information from program execution is fed back to LLMs for iterative refinement ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . However, prior evidence shows that such repair often yields only limited improvements ( Olausson et al., 2024 ) . This limitation is particularly evident in DL programs, where raw tracebacks often reveal only downstream symptoms of tensor-shape errors. Consequently, an LLM reasoning solely from such feedback lacks the evidence needed to localize upstream root causes. Moreover, even after the root cause is localized, self-repair without explicit shape guidance remains insufficient: resolving such errors requires accounting for how multiple interdependent API parameters jointly affect tensor shapes ( Deng et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 与这些问题相关的现有研究主要沿着两个方向展开。 其中一条研究路线采用检索增强生成（RAG）技术，将代码生成与外部知识相绑定（Zhou 等，2023；Chen 等，2025；Jain 等，2025）。 然而，其有效性在很大程度上依赖于能否检索到任务相关的上下文，因为无关信息可能会引入噪声并降低代码生成的质量（Gu 等，2025）。 在深度学习编程中，这一挑战因高层任务意图与精细 API 要求之间的差距而变得更加复杂，导致静态查询–文档匹配容易检索到无关的 API 知识（Su 等，2024）。 另一条研究路线则探索反馈引导的代码修复方法，即将程序执行中的失败信息反馈给大语言模型，以实现迭代优化（Shi 等，2024；Zhang 等，2023；Chen 等，2023）。 然而，已有证据表明，此类修复通常只能带来有限的改进（Olausson 等，2024）。 这一局限性在深度学习程序中尤为明显，因为原始堆栈跟踪往往仅能揭示张量形状错误所引发的下游症状。 因此，仅基于此类反馈进行推理的大语言模型缺乏定位上游根本原因所需的证据。 此外，即使定位了根本原因，若没有明确的形状指导，自我修复仍然不足：解决这类错误需要综合考虑多个相互依赖的 API 参数如何共同影响张量形状（Deng 等，2024）。

Therefore, this work aims to improve the syntactic correctness ( Problem 1 ) and runtime executability ( Problem 2 ) of LLM-generated DL programs. To this end, we identify one key retrieval challenge for mitigating API-level syntactic issues during code generation and two key challenges concerning the localization and repair of tensor-shape mismatches underlying runtime execution failures.

paragraphs.en: Challenge 3 (Repair) : How to infer shape-consistent API parameters for repair? Without explicit guidance on how interdependent API parameters jointly affect tensor shapes, LLMs struggle to identify configurations satisfying tensor-shape constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 挑战 3（修复）：如何推断出形状一致的修复用 API 参数？ 如果没有关于相互依赖的 API 参数如何共同影响张量形状的明确指导，大型语言模型将难以确定满足张量形状约束的配置。

sents.en: Challenge 3 (Repair) : How to infer shape-consistent API parameters for repair?
sents.zh: 挑战 3（修复）：如何推断出形状一致的修复用 API 参数？

sents.en: Without explicit guidance on how interdependent API parameters jointly affect tensor shapes, LLMs struggle to identify configurations satisfying tensor-shape constraints.
sents.zh: 如果没有关于相互依赖的 API 参数如何共同影响张量形状的明确指导，大型语言模型将难以确定满足张量形状约束的配置。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose DeepGroundRepair , a three-stage framework that establishes a generation-localization-repair workflow for DL programs, progressing from API-grounded retrieval-augmented generation through root-cause localization to shape-aware repair. Its main idea is to progressively narrow the generation and repair spaces using DL API knowledge and runtime tensor shapes as complementary guidance. API knowledge grounds code generation, while runtime tensor shapes support root-cause localization and constrain subsequent parameter-level repair. The three stages work in concert to address the challenges outlined above. (1) Reasoning-Augmented Classification Retrieval . To accurately obtain task-relevant API knowledge, DeepGroundRepair uses LLM-based API recommendation and existence verification to distinguish existing APIs from hallucinated ones, routing existing and nonexistent API candidates to sparse and dense retrieval, respectively. (2) Root-Cause API Localization . To localize where a tensor shape mismatch should be repaired, DeepGroundRepair combines static program analysis with dynamic execution traces to capture both program structure and runtime behavior. This combined analysis traces the mismatch from its failure site back to the upstream root-cause API and masks suspicious parameters. (3) Shape-Aware Self-Repair . To determine how the localized API should be repaired, DeepGroundRepair uses traced tensor shapes as explicit evidence and provides the LLM with retrieved shape-related knowledge for the root-cause API. This guidance enables the LLM to infer shape-consistent parameter values while respecting tensor-shape dependencies across the computation graph.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 DeepGroundRepair——一个包含三个阶段的框架，为 DL 程序建立了“生成-定位-修复”的工作流程：从基于 API 的检索增强生成，到根本原因定位，再到感知形状的修复。 其核心思想是利用 DL API 知识和运行时张量形状作为互补指导，逐步缩小生成和修复的空间范围。 API 知识为代码生成提供依据，而运行时张量形状则支持根本原因定位，并约束后续的参数级修复。 这三个阶段协同工作，以解决上述挑战。 (1) 推理增强型分类检索。 为了准确获取与任务相关的 API 知识，DeepGroundRepair 使用基于 LLM 的 API 推荐和存在性验证，区分现有 API 与幻觉生成的 API，并将现有和不存在候选 API 分别引导至稀疏检索和密集检索。 (2) 根本原因 API 定位。 为了定位张量形状不匹配需要修复的位置，DeepGroundRepair 将静态程序分析与动态执行轨迹相结合，以捕捉程序结构和运行时行为。 这种综合分析能够从不匹配的发生位置追溯至上游的根本原因 API，并对可疑参数进行标记。 (3) 感知形状的自我修复。 为了确定如何修复已定位的 API，DeepGroundRepair 将追溯到的张量形状作为明确证据，并为 LLM 提供与根本原因 API 相关的形状知识。 这种指导使 LLM 能够在尊重计算图中张量形状依赖关系的同时，推断出形状一致的参数值。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of DeepGroundRepair , we conduct experiments on the model-level DL code generation benchmark DeepEval using six open-weight LLMs from two model families across TensorFlow, PyTorch, and PaddlePaddle. We compare it against four baselines: two generation-only methods (vanilla LLM generation and Hybrid-RAG) and two methods combining their respective generation strategies with traceback-guided self-debugging. Across the three libraries, DeepGroundRepair reduces API hallucinations and parameter misuses by an average of 2.14 and 3.26 issues per 10 program files, respectively. Most notably, it improves code executability by an average of 85.3% relative to the four baselines. It also achieves an average relative improvement of 18.1% in semantic consistency over the two self-debugging baselines. Compared with these baselines, DeepGroundRepair further delivers higher code executability with 28.4% lower token cost on average.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估 DeepGroundRepair 的有效性，我们在模型级的深度学习代码生成基准 DeepEval 上进行了实验，该实验使用了来自 TensorFlow、PyTorch 和 PaddlePaddle 两个模型家族的六种开源大型语言模型（LLM）。 我们将它与四种基线方法进行了比较：两种仅基于生成的方法（原始 LLM 生成和 Hybrid-RAG），以及两种将各自的生成策略与回溯引导的自我调试相结合的方法。 在这三种库中，DeepGroundRepair 平均每 10 个程序文件中减少了 2.14 个 API 幻觉问题和 3.26 个参数误用问题。 最值得注意的是，与四种基线方法相比，它将代码的可执行性平均提升了 85.3%。 在语义一致性方面，它也比两种自我调试基线方法平均相对提升了 18.1%。 与这些基线方法相比，DeepGroundRepair 还实现了更高的代码可执行性，同时平均降低了 28.4% 的令牌成本。

paragraphs.en: In summary, this work makes the following contributions:

paragraphs.en: We propose DeepGroundRepair , a novel framework that bridges API-grounded code generation and shape-aware repair, enabling DL programs to be progressively improved through task-relevant API knowledge and runtime tensor-shape feedback.

paragraphs.en: Despite advances in LLM-based code generation, producing reliable DL programs remains challenging because it requires both library-specific API knowledge and effective repair of tensor-shape mismatches. This section presents representative failures of LLM-generated DL programs and highlights the key challenges motivating DeepGroundRepair .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管基于大型语言模型（LLM）的代码生成技术取得了进步，但生成可靠的深度学习（DL）程序仍然充满挑战，因为这既需要掌握特定库的 API 知识，也需要有效修复张量形状不匹配的问题。 本节介绍了 LLM 生成的深度学习程序中典型的失败案例，并指出了推动 DeepGroundRepair 项目发展的关键挑战。

sents.zh: 本节介绍了 LLM 生成的深度学习程序中典型的失败案例，并指出了推动 DeepGroundRepair 项目发展的关键挑战。

paragraphs.en: LLM-generated DL programs frequently contain API-level syntactic issues, including API hallucination and API parameter misuse ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Wei et al., 2022 ) . Figure 1 presents two representative examples. The first example demonstrates API hallucination, where the generated code invokes the nonexistent torch.nn.Concatenate API. The second example illustrates API parameter misuse, where paddle.nn.Conv2D is configured with the unsupported channels parameter while omitting the required in_channels and out_channels parameters.

paragraphs.en: These failures show that reliable DL code generation requires both identifying APIs that implement the intended operations and using them in accordance with their signatures and parameter specifications. Existing retrieval methods, however, often fail to provide such knowledge because task requirements express high-level modeling intents, whereas API documentation provides fine-grained, library-specific details. As shown in Figure 2 , directly using the complete task requirement as a dense-retrieval query fails to bridge this gap. Despite the target architecture implicit in the requirement, most retrieved APIs are irrelevant, and only one of the six required APIs, tensorflow.keras.layers.Softmax , appears among the top 10 candidates. This limitation motivates Stage 1, Reasoning-Augmented Classification Retrieval , which addresses our first challenge: How to provide LLMs with task-relevant DL API knowledge?

paragraphs.en: Beyond API-level syntactic issues, LLM-generated DL programs frequently encounter runtime failures. Our prior analysis of 3,677 failures across eight LLMs found tensor-shape mismatches to be the predominant failures type, accounting for 77.34% of execution failures on average ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . Such mismatches arise from violations of tensor-shape constraints during execution. As illustrated in Figure 3 , the generated program fails when the flattened feature tensor is passed to the fully connected layer. Specifically, the flattened tensor contains 401,408 features, whereas the configured in_features of nn.Linear is 25,088, leading to a shape incompatibility at the layer interface.

sents.zh: 具体来说，该扁平化张量包含 401,408 个特征，而 nn.Linear 中配置的 in_features 为 25,088，导致在层接口处出现形状不兼容问题。

paragraphs.en: This failure highlights two key challenges in tensor-shape-aware repair. First, the location where a mismatch is detected does not necessarily correspond to the API configuration that introduces the incompatible shape. In this example, the execution failure is reported at x=self.fc1(x) , whereas the faulty parameter configuration is defined earlier when constructing the nn.Linear layer in __init__ . Therefore, execution feedback alone may be insufficient for root-cause localization, whereas tracing tensor propagation can help identify the API configuration responsible for the mismatch. This observation motivates the design of Stage 2, Root-Cause Localization , to address the challenge: How to localize the root-cause API of a tensor-shape mismatch?
paragraphs.zh: 这一失败凸显了张量形状感知修复中的两个关键挑战。 首先，检测到不匹配的位置并不一定对应于引入不兼容形状的 API 配置。 在此示例中，执行失败报告发生在 x=self.fc1(x) 处，而错误的参数配置则是在 __init__ 中构建 nn.Linear 层时更早定义的。 因此，仅凭执行反馈可能不足以定位根本原因，而追踪张量传播则有助于识别导致不匹配的 API 配置。 这一观察结果促成了第二阶段“根本原因定位”的设计，以应对以下挑战：如何定位张量形状不匹配的根本原因 API？

paragraphs.en: Second, after localizing the root-cause API, repairing a mismatch requires inferring parameter values that satisfy tensor-shape constraints rather than performing unconstrained parameter repair. However, runtime tracebacks offer little guidance on how API parameters govern tensor transformations. Moreover, prior studies have shown that LLMs alone struggle to reason about complex numerical constraints among API parameters ( Deng et al., 2024 ) . Together, these limitations highlight the need for explicit shape guidance in valid parameter inference and motivate the design of Stage 3, Shape-Aware Self-Repair , to address the challenge: How to infer shape-consistent API parameters for repair?
paragraphs.zh: 其次，在定位到根本原因所在的 API 后，修复不匹配问题需要推断满足张量形状约束的参数值，而不是进行无约束的参数修复。 然而，运行时回溯对于 API 参数如何控制张量变换几乎没有提供指导。 此外，先前的研究已经表明，仅靠 LLM 难以对 API 参数之间的复杂数值约束进行推理（Deng 等人，2024）。 综合来看，这些局限性凸显了在有效参数推断中需要明确的形状指导，并推动了阶段 3——“感知形状的自我修复”的设计，以应对以下挑战：如何为修复推断出形状一致的 API 参数？

Together, these examples also motivate the generation–localization–repair workflow of DeepGroundRepair , which is introduced in the next section.

paragraphs.en: To address the challenges identified above, we propose DeepGroundRepair , a three-stage framework that implements a generation–localization–repair workflow for DL programs. As illustrated in Figure 4 , the framework progresses from Reasoning-Augmented Classification Retrieval (Stage 1) for API-grounded code generation, through Root-Cause Localization (Stage 2) for narrowing the repair space, to Shape-Aware Self-Repair (Stage 3) for deriving shape-consistent repairs. Together, these stages are designed to reduce API-level syntactic issues and improve code executability while preserving semantic consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决上述挑战，我们提出了 DeepGroundRepair——一个包含三个阶段的框架，用于实现 DL 程序的生成–定位–修复工作流程。 如图 4 所示，该框架首先通过推理增强分类检索（阶段 1）生成基于 API 的代码，接着进行根本原因定位（阶段 2）以缩小修复范围，最后通过形状感知自修复（阶段 3）推导出形状一致的修复方案。 这些阶段共同设计用于减少 API 层面的语法问题并提升代码的可执行性，同时保持语义一致性。

paragraphs.en: To support Stages 1 and 3, DeepGroundRepair constructs a library-specific API documentation database shared across the two stages. Rather than providing complete API documentation, the framework selectively retrieves knowledge tailored to each stage: Stage 1 uses API names, signatures, and descriptions to ground draft code generation, whereas Stage 3 uses the parameter description and tensor-shape transformation formulas of the localized root-cause API to guide repair. Details of database construction are provided in Section 4.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持阶段 1 和阶段 3，DeepGroundRepair 构建了一个针对特定库的 API 文档数据库，供这两个阶段共享。 该框架并未提供完整的 API 文档，而是选择性地检索与每个阶段相关的知识：阶段 1 使用 API 名称、签名和描述来为代码草案生成提供依据，而阶段 3 则利用局部化根本原因 API 的参数描述和张量形状转换公式来指导修复。 数据库构建的详细信息见第 4.4 节。

paragraphs.en: The three stages form an integrated pipeline, with the output of each preceding stage facilitating the next. The core idea and design objective of each stage are summarized below.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个阶段构成了一个集成的流程，每个前序阶段的输出都为下一阶段提供了便利。 每个阶段的核心思想和设计目标如下所述。

sents.en: The three stages form an integrated pipeline, with the output of each preceding stage facilitating the next.
sents.zh: 这三个阶段构成了一个集成的流程，每个前序阶段的输出都为下一阶段提供了便利。

sents.en: The core idea and design objective of each stage are summarized below.
sents.zh: 每个阶段的核心思想和设计目标如下所述。

paragraphs.en: (1) Stage 1: Reasoning-Augmented Classification Retrieval. This stage aims to reduce factual hallucinations in DL API usage by grounding code generation in task-relevant API knowledge. DeepGroundRepair first recommends the APIs required by the task and verifies their existence. Verified APIs are routed to sparse retrieval, whereas suspected hallucinations are routed to dense retrieval. The retrieved knowledge is then provided to the LLM to generate a more API-compliant draft program. Programs with tensor-shape mismatches proceed to Stage 2, whereas the few other execution failures are handled using the single-round traceback-guided strategy adopted by the self-debugging baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1：增强推理的分类检索。 该阶段旨在通过将代码生成与任务相关的 API 知识相绑定，减少使用 DL API 时出现的事实性幻觉。 DeepGroundRepair 首先推荐任务所需的 API，并验证其是否存在。 经过验证的 API 会被引导至稀疏检索，而疑似幻觉则会被引导至密集检索。 随后，检索到的知识会被提供给 LLM，以生成更符合 API 规范的程序草案。 存在张量形状不匹配的程序将进入阶段 2，而其他少数执行失败则使用自我调试基线方法所采用的单轮回溯引导策略进行处理。

paragraphs.en: (2) Stage 2: Root Cause Localization. Given the generated program, this stage narrows the repair space by identifying the root-cause API and masking its suspicious parameters. DeepGroundRepair combines abstract syntax tree (AST)-based static analysis with dynamic execution tracing to capture program structure and runtime tensor-shape propagation. The resulting parameter-masked program and traced tensor shapes provide focused context for shape-aware repair in Stage 3.
paragraphs.zh: (2) 阶段 2：根本原因定位。 基于生成的程序，此阶段通过识别根本原因 API 并屏蔽其可疑参数来缩小修复范围。 DeepGroundRepair 将基于抽象语法树（AST）的静态分析与动态执行追踪相结合，以捕捉程序结构和运行时张量形状的传播过程。 经过参数屏蔽的程序和追踪到的张量形状为阶段 3 中的形状感知修复提供了聚焦的上下文信息。

paragraphs.en: (3) Stage 3: Shape-Aware Self-Repair. Based on the localization results from Stage 2, this stage guides the LLM to self-repair the buggy program using explicit shape evidence and knowledge. The program is annotated with the traced shapes, which serve as explicit evidence for the LLM. Shape-related knowledge of the root-cause API, including parameter descriptions and tensor-shape transformation formulas, is then retrieved to augment the repair context. Combining this knowledge with runtime shape evidence, the LLM infers shape-consistent parameter values and uses them to resolve the tensor-shape mismatch.
paragraphs.zh: (3) 阶段 3：感知形状的自我修复。 基于阶段 2 的定位结果，本阶段指导 LLM 利用明确的形状证据和知识对存在错误的程序进行自我修复。 程序被标注了追踪到的形状，这些形状作为 LLM 的明确证据。 随后，系统会检索与根本原因 API 相关的形状知识（包括参数描述和张量形状转换公式），以增强修复上下文。 通过结合这些知识与运行时形状证据，LLM 能够推断出形状一致的参数值，并利用这些值解决张量形状不匹配的问题。

paragraphs.en: Naive RAG directly retrieves API documentation using high-level task requirements, leaving a semantic gap between DL programming intent and fine-grained API knowledge. Moreover, static query–document matching cannot reliably uncover the APIs implicitly required to implement complex DL model architectures. To bridge this gap, this stage prompts the LLM to reason over the task requirement and identify candidate APIs implicitly required to implement the target DL models. It then verifies these candidates and routes existing and hallucinated candidates to sparse and dense retrieval, respectively. Algorithm 1 summarizes the workflow of this stage, and the individual steps are detailed below.
paragraphs.zh: 朴素 RAG 直接使用高级任务要求检索 API 文档，导致深度学习编程意图与精细的 API 知识之间存在语义鸿沟。 此外，静态的查询–文档匹配无法可靠地发现实现复杂深度学习模型架构所隐式需要的 API。 为了弥合这一差距，本阶段会提示 LLM 对任务要求进行推理，并识别出实现目标深度学习模型所隐式需要的候选 API。 随后，它会验证这些候选项，并将现有的候选项与幻觉生成的候选项分别引导至稀疏检索和密集检索。 算法 1 总结了本阶段的工作流程，具体步骤将在下文详细说明。

paragraphs.en: (1) LLM-Based Reasoning for API Recommendation. To address the semantic gap between task requirements and API documentation, DeepGroundRepair prompts the LLM to reason about which library-specific APIs are implicitly required by each task. The LLM then produces a structured list of candidate API names, translating the task description into an intermediate representation closer to the API documentation space. For reproducibility, we provide the prompt template used for API recommendation in Figure 10 .

paragraphs.en: (2) API Existence Verification. After obtaining the API names recommended by the LLM, DeepGroundRepair verifies each candidate against the target DL library. The probabilistic nature of LLM generation introduces uncertainty into recommendations. Moreover, LLM parametric knowledge of library-specific APIs may be imprecise, particularly for less widely used libraries such as PaddlePaddle. Consequently, the recommendations may include hallucinated API names. Directly using such candidates as queries may return task-irrelevant API documentation, thereby misguiding the LLM during subsequent code generation. paragraphs.en: Despite API-grounded generation, the draft program may still contain tensor-shape faults that emerge only at runtime. These faults are difficult to diagnose because layer parameters defined in the model initialization method ( __init__ ) govern tensor transformations in the forward-computation method ( forward or call ) 1 1 1 forward is used in PyTorch and PaddlePaddle, whereas call is used in TensorFlow. , while the resulting mismatches may surface only at downstream operations. Consequently, a traceback typically identifies only the crash site, not the upstream API and parameters causing the mismatch. To address this limitation, Stage 2 backtracks tensor propagation from the crash line to localize the root-cause API and mask its suspicious parameters. This process narrows the repair space and provides focused guidance for Stage 3. Algorithm 2 summarizes the workflow of this stage, and the individual steps are detailed below.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管程序是基于 API 生成的，但草案中仍可能包含仅在运行时才会出现的张量形状错误。 这些错误难以诊断，因为模型初始化方法（__init__）中定义的层参数控制着前向计算方法（forward 或 call）中的张量变换；其中，PyTorch 和 PaddlePaddle 使用 forward，而 TensorFlow 使用 call，且由此产生的不匹配可能直到下游操作才会显现。 因此，堆栈跟踪通常只能确定崩溃位置，而无法识别导致不匹配的上游 API 和参数。 为了解决这一局限性，阶段 2 会从崩溃行开始反向追踪张量传播路径，以定位根本原因所在的 API，并标记其可疑参数。 这一过程能够缩小修复范围，并为阶段 3 提供有针对性的指导。 算法 2 总结了该阶段的流程，具体步骤将在下文详细说明。

paragraphs.en: Tensor Shape Tracing. This step reconstructs runtime tensor propagation by tracing intermediate tensor shapes throughout forward execution. DeepGroundRepair first performs AST-based static analysis of the generated program to identify function calls and tensor variables involved in forward computation as candidate observation points. It then executes the program with line-level tracing using sys.settrace , recording tensor shapes at these points until an exception occurs. The resulting trace provides explicit tensor-shape context for Stage 3 and auxiliary evidence for root-cause localization.
paragraphs.zh: 张量形状追踪。 此步骤通过追踪正向执行过程中所有中间张量的形状，重建运行时张量的传播过程。 DeepGroundRepair 首先对生成的程序进行基于 AST 的静态分析，以识别参与正向计算的函数调用和张量变量作为候选观察点。 随后，它使用 sys.settrace 进行逐行追踪执行程序，在这些点上记录张量形状，直到发生异常。 所得的追踪结果提供了第 3 阶段所需的明确张量形状上下文，并为根本原因定位提供了辅助证据。

paragraphs.en: Root-Cause API Localization. When a crash occurs, DeepGroundRepair locates the failing operation from the traceback and uses AST-based data-flow analysis to trace the involved tensors backward through the forward computation. The recorded shapes reveal how tensor dimensions change along this dependency path, helping identify the layer configuration inconsistent with runtime tensor propagation. The framework then maps the relevant layer instance to its constructor call in __init__ and identifies the corresponding API as the root cause. The Stage 2 panel of Figure 4 illustrates this process using an excerpt from the tensor-mismatch example in Figure 3 . Specifically, the traceback points to self.fc1(x) in forward , while the shape trace records the dimensions of x . The AST analysis then maps self.fc1 to the nn.Linear constructor assigned to it in __init__ .

paragraphs.en: Buggy Parameter Masking. Once the root-cause API is localized, DeepGroundRepair selects and masks its potentially responsible parameters. It first maps library-specific layer APIs to unified semantic layer categories, such as convolutional, pooling, and fully connected layers. Each semantic layer category has predefined masking rules for channel and spatial mismatches, specifying which API parameters control the corresponding tensor dimensions. DeepGroundRepair then infers the mismatch type from the traced tensor shapes and applies the corresponding rule for the root-cause API’s category. For a channel mismatch, the rule masks parameters governing the expected number of input or output channels, as illustrated by the masked in_features argument in the Stage 2 panel of Figure 4 . For a spatial mismatch, it masks parameters governing the output height and width, as illustrated by the masked kernel_size , strides , and padding arguments of the root-cause self.conv_branch layer in Figure 5 .

paragraphs.en: To relate API parameters to the target tensor shape, DeepGroundRepair retrieves parameter descriptions and, when available, tensor-shape transformation formulas for the root-cause API. As shown in Figure 6 , the retrieved knowledge for tensorflow.keras.layers.Conv2D comprises a structured parameter–description mapping and the corresponding transformation formulas. The semantic mapping indicates that kernel_size , strides , and padding govern the output spatial dimensions, whereas filters determines the output channels. Under the channels-last format 2 2 2 N N denotes batch size, while H H , W W , and C C denote height, width, and channel count, respectively. Subscripts in \mathrm{in} and out \mathrm{out} distinguish input and output. , the formulas characterize how the tensor shape transforms from ( N , H in , W in , C in ) (N,H_{\mathrm{in}},W_{\mathrm{in}},C_{\mathrm{in}}) to ( N , H out , W out , C out ) (N,H_{\mathrm{out}},W_{\mathrm{out}},C_{\mathrm{out}}) as governed by the corresponding API parameters. Together, the parameter descriptions and tensor shape transformation formulas guide the LLM in coordinating parameter values to satisfy cross-path shape constraints.

paragraphs.en: Shape-Aware Code Repair. To account for their different dependency scopes, DeepGroundRepair adopts distinct repair strategies for intra-path and inter-path mismatches. For intra-path mismatches, DeepGroundRepair prompts the LLM to generate a repaired code line from the shape-annotated and parameter-masked program. The generated line then replaces the corresponding masked API call in the original code.

paragraphs.en: For inter-path mismatches, DeepGroundRepair adopts a generate-and-validate strategy. In the example shown in Figure 5 , the shape of the main-path tensor entering Add defines the target shape for the output of the shortcut-path Conv2D . Using annotations that capture this target shape and tensor-shape propagation process, together with retrieved shape-related knowledge for Conv2D , the LLM proposes candidate combinations for the masked parameter values. A lightweight constraint solver then evaluates each combination by checking whether the resulting Conv2D output matches the target shape. Finally, the validated combination, comprising kernel_size=(3,3) , strides=(2,2) , and padding="same" , is inserted into the masked Conv2D call to produce the repaired code. For reproducibility, the prompt templates for intra-path and inter-path repair are provided in Figures 12 and 13 , respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 对于路径间的不匹配，DeepGroundRepair 采用“生成-验证”策略。 在图 5 所示的例子中，进入 Add 操作的主路径张量的形状定义了快捷路径中 Conv2D 输出的目标形状。 利用能够捕捉该目标形状和张量形状传播过程的标注信息，并结合检索到的与 Conv2D 相关的形状知识，LLM 会提出被掩码参数值的候选组合。 随后，一个轻量级约束求解器会通过检查生成的 Conv2D 输出是否与目标形状匹配来评估每种组合。 最后，经过验证的组合（包括 kernel_size=(3,3)、strides=(2,2) 和 padding="same"）将被插入到被掩码的 Conv2D 调用中，从而生成修复后的代码。 为确保可重复性，路径内和路径间修复的提示模板分别提供在图 12 和图 13 中。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness of DeepGroundRepair , we compare it with four baselines: two generation-only baselines ( Baselines 1 and 2 ) and their self-debugging counterparts ( Baselines 3 and 4 ), which perform one traceback-guided repair iteration upon execution failure.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 DeepGroundRepair 的有效性，我们将其与四个基线模型进行了比较：两个仅用于生成的基线模型（基线 1 和 2），以及它们具备自我调试能力的对应版本（基线 3 和 4），后者在执行失败时会执行一次由回溯引导的修复迭代。

paragraphs.en: This baseline uses zero-shot prompting to generate DL programs directly from the task requirements. It evaluates the model’s fundamental ability to generate DL programs without retrieval augmentation or iterative repair.
paragraphs.zh: 该基线方法使用零样本提示，直接从任务要求中生成深度学习程序。 它评估了模型在没有检索增强或迭代修复的情况下生成深度学习程序的基本能力。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has shown that execution feedback can help LLMs diagnose and repair errors in generated programs ( Shi et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) . Following this feedback-guided paradigm, Baseline 3 augments vanilla LLM generation with traceback-guided self-debugging. It generates an initial code solution using the same setting as Baseline 1 and executes it. If execution fails, the LLM performs a repair iteration using the resulting runtime traceback as feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的研究已经表明，执行反馈可以帮助大型语言模型诊断并修复生成程序中的错误（Shi 等人，2024；Chen 等人，2023）。 遵循这种以反馈为指导的范式，Baseline 3 在常规的大型语言模型生成过程中加入了由回溯信息引导的自我调试机制。 它使用与 Baseline 1 相同的设置生成初始代码解决方案，然后执行该代码。 如果执行失败，大型语言模型会将产生的运行时回溯信息作为反馈，进行一轮修复迭代。

paragraphs.en: This section presents the evaluation metrics used to compare DeepGroundRepair with baseline methods. The metrics are categorized into three groups according to their evaluation objectives: end-to-end effectiveness metrics for RQ1, RQ2, and RQ4; stage-specific effectiveness metrics for RQ3; and the token efficiency metric for RQ5.

paragraphs.en: We employ Pylint ( , 2026 ) , a widely used static analysis tool, to identify API-level syntactic issues. We focus on the Error messages reported by Pylint 3 3 3 We exclude other Pylint message categories ( Fatal , Refactor , Warning , and Convention ) because they are rare or capture lower-severity issues. We also filter out false positives due to TensorFlow’s lazy-loading mechanism, such as the import-error report for tensorflow.keras.layers . , which indicate severe issues that may affect program correctness. Based on their categories, we define two metrics: API Hallucination Count and API Parameter Misuse Count .

paragraphs.en: In this work, we adopt DeepEval ( Ma et al., 2026 ) as our evaluation benchmark. To the best of our knowledge, DeepEval was the only benchmark specifically designed to evaluate model-level DL code generation when this study was conducted. It comprises 100 tasks, each consisting of a natural-language requirement and a reference implementation. The requirement specifies the model inputs, architecture, and outputs. Unlike general-purpose code generation benchmarks centered on standalone functions ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Shin et al., 2024 ) , DeepEval focuses on the construction of complete DL models, enabling the evaluation of LLM-generated DL programs at the model level.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们采用 DeepEval（Ma 等人，2026）作为我们的评估基准。 据我们所知，在本研究进行期间，DeepEval 是唯一专门用于评估模型级深度学习代码生成能力的基准。 它包含 100 个任务，每个任务都由一个自然语言需求和参考实现组成。 该需求明确了模型的输入、架构和输出。 与以独立函数为中心的一般性代码生成基准（Chen 等人，2021；Shin 等人，2024）不同，DeepEval 专注于完整深度学习模型的构建，从而能够以模型级别评估大型语言模型生成的深度学习程序。

paragraphs.en: To support retrieval in Stages 1 and 3 of DeepGroundRepair , we construct library-specific API documentation databases for the three target DL libraries. We first use BeautifulSoup to parse the official online API documentation of TensorFlow 5 5 5 https://www.tensorflow.org/api_docs/python/tf , PyTorch 6 6 6 https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.11/pytorch-api.html , and PaddlePaddle 7 7 7 https://www.paddlepaddle.org.cn/documentation/docs/en/api/index_en.html , collecting 3,686, 4,137, and 1,531 API documents, respectively. We then preprocess the raw documents using GPT-5.4-mini to remove noise and shorten subsequent prompts, thereby helping the LLM focus on essential API information ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . Specifically, we normalize API signatures, remove nonessential parameters, and condense API and parameter descriptions. Finally, we organize the processed documents into library-specific databases and build separate sparse and dense retrieval indexes for each database.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持 DeepGroundRepair 第 1 阶段和第 3 阶段的检索，我们为三个目标深度学习库构建针对各库的 API 文档数据库。 我们首先使用 BeautifulSoup 解析 TensorFlow 5 5 5 https://www.tensorflow.org/api_docs/python/tf、PyTorch 6 6 6 https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/2.11/pytorch-api.html 和 PaddlePaddle 7 7 7 https://www.paddlepaddle.org.cn/documentation/docs/en/api/index_en.html 的官方在线 API 文档，分别收集到 3,686、4,137 和 1,531 份 API 文档。 接着，我们使用 GPT-5.4-mini 对原始文档进行预处理，以去除噪声并缩短后续提示词，从而帮助大语言模型专注于关键的 API 信息（Liu et al., 2024）。 具体而言，我们对 API 签名进行标准化，移除非必要的参数，并精简 API 和参数的描述。 最后，我们将处理后的文档整理为各库专用的数据库，并为每个数据库分别构建稀疏检索索引和密集检索索引。

paragraphs.en: Using the constructed API documentation databases, we configure both sparse and dense retrieval. For sparse retrieval, we use BM25 ( Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009 ) , implemented with the Whoosh package ( , 2026 ) , to rank API documents based on lexical matches between each query and the structured API fields. For dense retrieval, we use BGE-M3 ( Chen et al., 2024 ) to encode queries and documents into embedding vectors. FAISS ( Douze et al., 2026 ) indexes the document vectors and performs similarity search. In DeepGroundRepair , existing and nonexistent API candidates are routed to sparse and dense retrieval, respectively. The top-ranked document for each query is retained, yielding up to 10 API documents as context for the LLM. By contrast, Hybrid-RAG applies both retrieval methods to each query and fuses their ranked results using reciprocal rank fusion (RRF) ( Cormack et al., 2009 ) , retaining the top 10 documents after fusion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们利用构建好的 API 文档数据库，配置稀疏检索和密集检索。 在稀疏检索中，我们使用 BM25（Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009），通过 Whoosh 包（, 2026）实现，根据每个查询与结构化 API 字段之间的词汇匹配来对 API 文档进行排序。 在密集检索中，我们使用 BGE-M3（Chen et al., 2024）将查询和文档编码为嵌入向量。 FAISS（Douze et al., 2026）对文档向量建立索引并执行相似度搜索。 在 DeepGroundRepair 中，现有和不存在 API 候选项分别被引导至稀疏检索和密集检索。 每个查询的排名最高的文档会被保留，从而为 LLM 提供最多 10 个 API 文档作为上下文。 相比之下，Hybrid-RAG 对每个查询同时应用两种检索方法，并使用互惠排名融合（RRF）（Cormack et al., 2009）融合它们的排序结果，在融合后保留排名最高的 10 个文档。

paragraphs.en: To ensure a fair comparison, we evaluate all methods using identical hardware and software configurations. paragraphs.en: To assess the end-to-end effectiveness of DeepGroundRepair , we evaluate whether it alleviates the two problems identified in Section 1 : API-level syntactic issues and runtime execution failures. We present the detailed results in the order of static checking, dynamic checking, and semantic checking, using the metrics defined in Section 4.2.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 DeepGroundRepair 的整体有效性，我们检验了它是否缓解了第 1 节中识别出的两个问题：API 级别的语法问题和运行时执行失败。 我们按照静态检查、动态检查和语义检查的顺序，使用第 4.2.1 节中定义的指标呈现了详细结果。

sents.en: We present the detailed results in the order of static checking, dynamic checking, and semantic checking, using the metrics defined in Section 4.2.1 .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate two API-level syntactic issues: API hallucination and API parameter misuse. As shown in Table 2 , averaged over comparisons with four baselines across 18 model–library configurations, DeepGroundRepair produces 2.14 fewer API hallucinations and 3.26 fewer API parameter misuses per 10 programs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了两个 API 级别的语法问题：API 幻觉和 API 参数误用。 如表 2 所示，在 18 种模型-库配置中与四种基线模型进行比较后取平均值，DeepGroundRepair 每 10 个程序可减少 2.14 次 API 幻觉和 3.26 次 API 参数误用。

sents.en: As shown in Table 2 , averaged over comparisons with four baselines across 18 model–library configurations, DeepGroundRepair produces 2.14 fewer API hallucinations and 3.26 fewer API parameter misuses per 10 programs.
sents.zh: 如表 2 所示，在 18 种模型-库配置中与四种基线模型进行比较后取平均值，DeepGroundRepair 每 10 个程序可减少 2.14 次 API 幻觉和 3.26 次 API 参数误用。

paragraphs.en: For API hallucination, DeepGroundRepair achieves the lowest average API Hallucination Count on TensorFlow and PaddlePaddle, with 0.10 and 3.33 issues per 10 program files, respectively. Compared with the four baselines, it reduces hallucinations by 0.25–0.71 issues on TensorFlow and 4.09–7.10 issues on PaddlePaddle. The particularly large reductions on PaddlePaddle suggest that DeepGroundRepair is especially beneficial when LLMs have limited parametric knowledge of less widely used DL libraries. On PyTorch, DeepGroundRepair outperforms Baselines 1–3 and remains close to Baseline 4 , with only 0.18 more issues per 10 program files.

On PaddlePaddle, DeepGroundRepair substantially outperforms Baseline 1 and Baseline 3 , remains comparable to Baseline 2 , and produces 0.29 more issues than Baseline 4 . Thus, the reductions are most pronounced in settings where the baselines exhibit substantial API misuse.

paragraphs.en: Static checking captures API-level syntactic issues but cannot reveal runtime failures; we therefore execute the final programs and measure their executability using CER . As shown in Table 3 , averaged over the comparisons with four baselines across the 18 model–library configurations, DeepGroundRepair achieves a relative CER improvement of 85.3%.
paragraphs.zh: 静态检查可以捕捉 API 层面的语法问题，但无法揭示运行时故障；因此，我们执行最终程序，并使用 CER 衡量其可执行性。 如表 3 所示，在 18 种模型-库配置中，与四种基线方法进行比较并取平均值后，DeepGroundRepair 实现了 85.3% 的相对 CER 提升。

sents.en: As shown in Table 3 , averaged over the comparisons with four baselines across the 18 model–library configurations, DeepGroundRepair achieves a relative CER improvement of 85.3%.
sents.zh: 如表 3 所示，在 18 种模型-库配置中，与四种基线方法进行比较并取平均值后，DeepGroundRepair 实现了 85.3% 的相对 CER 提升。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 3 , DeepGroundRepair achieves the highest overall CER on all three DL libraries, reaching 58.2% on TensorFlow, 41.2% on PyTorch, and 31.5% on PaddlePaddle. Compared with the strongest baseline for each library, DeepGroundRepair yields relative gains of 13.7%, 31.6%, and 60.0%, respectively. Compared with the generation-only baselines, it improves CER by 54.0%–275.9%, showing the benefit of applying targeted repair to initially generated code. It also outperforms the self-debugging baselines by 13.7%–75.3%, demonstrating that the complete DeepGroundRepair pipeline is more effective than existing traceback-guided self-debugging methods.

paragraphs.en: Across 18 model–library configurations, DeepGroundRepair achieves the highest CER in 15 configurations and ties for the highest in one. The only two configurations in which it is outperformed are Mistral-14B and Mistral-24B on TensorFlow, where Baseline 4 achieves CER of 66% and 83%, compared with 59% and 66% for DeepGroundRepair . However, Baseline 4 exhibits lower SCR in these configurations: 75.8% and 83.0%, compared with 98.0% and 91.9% for DeepGroundRepair . These cases highlight the need to consider executability and semantic consistency jointly, as discussed below.

paragraphs.en: To assess whether improved executability comes at the cost of reduced semantic consistency, we use SCR to compare programs before and after repair. As shown in Table 4 , DeepGroundRepair achieves average SCR values of 94.02%, 96.45%, and 93.73% on TensorFlow, PyTorch, and PaddlePaddle, respectively. At the configuration level, it obtains the highest SCR in 16 of the 18 model–library configurations. Overall, these results represent an average relative improvement of 18.1% over the two self-debugging baselines across the three libraries.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估执行性提升是否以语义一致性降低为代价，我们使用 SCR 来比较修复前后的程序。 如表 4 所示，DeepGroundRepair 在 TensorFlow、PyTorch 和 PaddlePaddle 上的平均 SCR 值分别为 94.02%、96.45% 和 93.73%。 在配置层面，它在 18 种模型-库配置中有 16 种获得了最高的 SCR。 总体而言，这些结果在三款库上相较于两种自我调试基线方法平均相对提升了 18.1%。

paragraphs.en: To quantify the contribution of each stage of DeepGroundRepair , we conduct an ablation study in which one stage is removed at a time while all other stages remain unchanged. Following the evaluation procedure described in Section 5.1 , we assess each ablated variant through static checking, dynamic checking, and semantic checking using the end-to-end effectiveness metrics defined in Section 4.2.1 . The variants are described below.
paragraphs.zh: 为了量化 DeepGroundRepair 每个阶段的贡献，我们进行了一项消融研究：每次移除一个阶段，而其他所有阶段保持不变。 遵循第 5.1 节中描述的评估流程，我们通过静态检查、动态检查和语义检查来评估每个经过消融的变体，并使用第 4.2.1 节中定义的全局有效性指标进行衡量。 这些变体的描述如下。

sents.en: Following the evaluation procedure described in Section 5.1 , we assess each ablated variant through static checking, dynamic checking, and semantic checking using the end-to-end effectiveness metrics defined in Section 4.2.1 .
sents.zh: 遵循第 5.1 节中描述的评估流程，我们通过静态检查、动态检查和语义检查来评估每个经过消融的变体，并使用第 4.2.1 节中定义的全局有效性指标进行衡量。

sents.en: The variants are described below.
sents.zh: 这些变体的描述如下。

paragraphs.en: Variant 1 (w/o Reasoning-Augmented Classification Retrieval ): Removes retrieved DL API knowledge and instead uses vanilla LLM generation to produce draft programs.
paragraphs.zh: 变体 1（无推理增强分类检索）：移除检索到的 DL API 知识，转而使用基础 LLM 生成来产出程序草案。

paragraphs.en: Variant 2 (w/o Root-Cause Localization ): Removes the localized root-cause API and parameter masks from the repair context, using only the raw runtime traceback as repair guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 变体 2（无根本原因定位）：从修复上下文中移除本地化的根本原因 API 和参数掩码，仅使用原始运行时堆栈跟踪作为修复指导。

paragraphs.en: Variant 3 (w/o Shape-A-Aware Self-Repair ): Removes tensor-shape annotations and shape-related API knowledge from the repair context, leaving the LLM without explicit shape guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 变体 3（无形状感知自我修复）：从修复上下文中移除张量形状注释和与形状相关的 API 知识，使 LLM 无法获得明确的外形指导。

paragraphs.en: Static checking. As shown in Table 5 , removing Reasoning-Augmented Classification Retrieval in Variant 1 consistently lowers static correctness across all three libraries. Compared with DeepGroundRepair , Variant 1 increases API Hallucination Count by 0.30–1.31 and API Parameter Misuse Count by 0.05–5.92 issues per 10 program files. By contrast, Variant 2 and Variant 3 have smaller and less consistent effects. Although they occasionally reduce issue counts for individual library–metric combinations, these improvements are isolated and do not generalize across libraries. Overall, the consistent performance degradation of Variant 1 relative to DeepGroundRepair demonstrates the importance of Reasoning-Augmented Classification Retrieval in reducing API-level syntactic issues.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we evaluate how effectively the three stages of DeepGroundRepair address the corresponding challenges identified in Section 1 : retrieving task-relevant API knowledge, localizing root-cause APIs, and repairing incorrect parameters under tensor-shape constraints. This analysis further clarifies the mechanisms underlying each stage’s contribution and helps explain the ablation results in RQ2.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们评估 DeepGroundRepair 的三个阶段在应对第 1 节中识别出的相应挑战方面的有效性：检索与任务相关的 API 知识、定位根本原因所在的 API，以及在张量形状约束下修复不正确的参数。 这一分析进一步阐明了每个阶段所起作用背后的机制，并有助于解释 RQ2 中的消融实验结果。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the retrieval accuracy of Reasoning-Augmented Classification Retrieval of DeepGroundRepair using Precision@10 and Recall@10 and compare it with the Hybrid-RAG.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Precision@10 和 Recall@10 来评估 DeepGroundRepair 的推理增强分类检索的检索准确性，并将其与 Hybrid-RAG 进行比较。

paragraphs.en: API ground-truth set construction. To establish relevance labels for evaluating retrieval accuracy, we construct a library-specific API ground-truth set for each task based on the reference implementation of DeepEval. Specifically, one author extracts API calls from the reference code and maps them to corresponding or functionally equivalent APIs in TensorFlow, PyTorch, and PaddlePaddle. Another author then independently verifies all extracted APIs and mappings against the official library documentation to ensure their correctness and equivalence. The resulting task-specific sets are used as relevance labels for computing Precision@10 and Recall@10 .
paragraphs.zh: API 基准事实集构建。 为了建立用于评估检索准确性的相关性标签，我们基于 DeepEval 的参考实现，为每个任务构建一个特定于库的 API 基准事实集。 具体来说，一位作者从参考代码中提取 API 调用，并将其映射到 TensorFlow、PyTorch 和 PaddlePaddle 中对应或功能等效的 API。 随后，另一位作者独立验证所有提取出的 API 和映射，对照官方库文档以确保其正确性和等效性。 最终得到的任务特定集被用作相关性标签，用于计算 Precision@10 和 Recall@10。

paragraphs.en: Overall result. As shown in Table 8 , Stage 1 of DeepGroundRepair substantially outperforms Hybrid-RAG on both metrics across all 18 combinations of recommender LLMs and DL libraries. Averaged across the six LLMs, the improvements range from 55.4 to 74.7 percentage points in Precision@10 and from 56.2 to 83.5 percentage points in Recall@10 across the three libraries. These substantial and consistent improvements demonstrate the effectiveness of Reasoning-Augmented Classification Retrieval in retrieving task-relevant APIs.

paragraphs.en: Mechanism analysis. Reasoning-Augmented Classification Retrieval verifies each LLM-recommended API and routes it according to its existence: existing APIs to sparse retrieval and hallucinated candidates to dense retrieval. This strategy preserves the precise lexical signals of existing API names while exploiting the semantic information in hallucinated candidates to recover valid alternatives. As illustrated in Table 9 , torch.nn.functional.add does not exist but captures the intended tensor-addition operation. Reasoning-Augmented Classification Retrieval therefore uses dense retrieval rather than sparse retrieval and successfully recovers the valid API torch.add .
paragraphs.zh: 机制分析。 推理增强分类检索会验证每个由 LLM 推荐的 API，并根据其是否存在进行路由：将现有 API 导向稀疏检索，将幻觉候选项导向密集检索。 该策略既保留了现有 API 名称的精确词汇信号，又利用了幻觉候选项中的语义信息来恢复有效的替代方案。 如表 9 所示，torch.nn.functional.add 并不存在，但它捕捉到了预期的张量加法操作。 因此，推理增强分类检索使用密集检索而非稀疏检索，并成功恢复了有效的 API torch.add。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2 aims to localize the root-cause API underlying an execution failure rather than merely the API at which the failure manifests. On programs that fail during initial execution, we use two complementary metrics to assess failure-site–root-cause discrepancies and the localization accuracy of Stage 2. Failure-Site–Root-Cause Discrepancy Rate ( FRDR ) measures the proportion of cases where the traceback-reported failure site is not the actual root-cause location. Root-Cause API Localization Accuracy ( RCLA ) measures the proportion of cases in which Stage 2 correctly identifies the manually annotated root-cause API.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 2 的目标是定位执行失败的根本原因所在 API，而不仅仅是失败表现出的 API。 对于在初始执行过程中失败的程序，我们使用两种互补的指标来评估失败位置与根本原因之间的差异以及阶段 2 的定位准确性。 失败位置-根本原因差异率（FRDR）衡量的是回溯报告中的失败位置并非实际根本原因所在位置的案例比例。 根本原因 API 定位准确率（RCLA）衡量的是阶段 2 正确识别出人工标注的根本原因 API 的案例比例。

paragraphs.en: Root-cause API ground-truth set construction. To balance representativeness and annotation cost, we used the medium-sized model from each family, Gemma-12B and Mistral-14B. From the 351 programs generated by these models that failed during initial execution, we selected 120 cases through stratified random sampling ( Neuendorf, 2017 ) by model and DL library. One author manually annotated the root-cause API of each failure based on the source code and runtime traceback, without access to the predictions of Stage 2. A second author reviewed ambiguous cases to finalize the ground-truth labels. These labels were then used to evaluate the root-cause APIs localized by Stage 2.

paragraphs.en: Mechanism analysis. The high FRDR indicates that a tensor incompatibility is usually reported downstream of the API that caused it, making traceback information alone insufficient for reliable root-cause localization. Stage 2 instead backtracks tensor-transformation dependencies from the reported failure site to upstream API configurations, enabling consistent localization accuracy across libraries. This effect is particularly evident for TensorFlow: despite an FRDR of 100.0%, Stage 2 achieves an RCLA of 83.3%.

paragraphs.en: Comparison across DL libraries. The performance of DeepGroundRepair varies across the target DL libraries. paragraphs.en: In this section, we discuss the limitations and opportunities of our approach, followed by threats to validity.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将讨论我们方法的局限性和机遇，随后探讨对有效性的威胁。

paragraphs.en: Although DeepGroundRepair is effective in improving LLM-generated DL programs through API-grounded generation, root-cause localization, and shape-aware repair, it has several limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 DeepGroundRepair 通过基于 API 的生成、根本原因定位和形状感知修复，在改进 LLM 生成的 DL 程序方面效果显著，但它也存在一些局限性。

paragraphs.en: First, DeepGroundRepair primarily addresses API-level syntactic issues and tensor-shape mismatches, which are among the most prevalent failure categories observed in our evaluation. Its current design provides limited support for other DL-specific failures, including dtype or device incompatibilities, numerical instability, and training divergence. Incorporating failure-specific diagnostic capabilities and domain knowledge could enable more comprehensive analysis and repair of DL programs.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，DeepGroundRepair 主要解决 API 级别的语法问题和张量形状不匹配问题，这些问题是我们评估中观察到的最普遍故障类别之一。 其当前设计对其他深度学习特定的故障支持有限，包括数据类型或设备不兼容、数值不稳定以及训练发散等问题。 融入针对特定故障的诊断能力和领域知识，将有助于对深度学习程序进行更全面的分析和修复。

paragraphs.en: Second, the effectiveness of shape-aware analysis depends on observable tensor propagation and formalizable API semantics. Complex control flows, custom operators, and incomplete API documentation can hinder accurate tensor-flow tracing and shape-constraint validation. Advanced program-analysis techniques, such as symbolic execution, could strengthen tensor reasoning in these complex settings.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，形状感知分析的有效性取决于可观测的张量传播和可形式化的 API 语义。 复杂的控制流、自定义算子以及不完整的 API 文档可能会阻碍对张量流的准确追踪以及对形状约束的有效验证。 高级程序分析技术（例如符号执行）可以在这些复杂场景下增强张量推理能力。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the current strategy performs parameter-level repair within a single iteration. Programs containing multiple independent errors may require repeated execution–repair cycles. Errors requiring architectural changes fall outside the scope of parameter-level repair and demand broader code revisions. Adaptive multi-step strategies could address these cases by dynamically determining the appropriate repair granularity and leveraging intermediate validation feedback. Such strategies could progressively resolve complex failures while maintaining repair efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，当前策略在单次迭代内执行参数级修复。 包含多个独立错误的程序可能需要重复的执行-修复循环。 需要架构变更的错误超出了参数级修复的范畴，必须对代码进行更广泛的修改。 自适应多步策略可以通过动态确定合适的修复粒度并利用中间验证反馈来处理这些情况。 此类策略可以在保持修复效率的同时，逐步解决复杂的故障。

paragraphs.en: We discuss potential threats to the internal and external validity of this study.
paragraphs.zh: 我们讨论了本研究内部和外部效度可能面临的威胁。

paragraphs.en: Internal Validity. The inherent stochasticity of LLMs may cause variations in generated programs. To reduce this variation, we use consistent model configurations, prompts, and experimental environments within each comparison. Metric selection may also affect the results. Although we employ complementary static, dynamic, and semantic checks, each has inherent limitations. Pylint detects only predefined issue categories and may produce false positives, although we exclude most identifiable cases. Successful execution does not guarantee functional correctness, and effective-line-count preservation is only a proxy for semantic consistency. Combining these metrics reduces reliance on any single measure. Finally, the ground-truth API sets and root-cause APIs used in the stage-specific evaluations require human annotation. We mitigate potential annotation bias by applying consistent guidelines and cross-checking annotations against reference implementations, API documentation, and runtime traces.
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 LLM 固有的随机性可能导致生成的程序出现差异。 为减少这种差异，我们在每次比较中均使用一致的模型配置、提示词和实验环境。 指标的选择也可能影响结果。 尽管我们采用了互补的静态、动态和语义检查，但每种检查都存在固有局限性。 Pylint 仅能检测预定义的问题类别，并可能产生误报，不过我们已排除了大多数可识别的情况。 成功执行并不保证功能正确性，而有效行数保持不变也仅是语义一致性的代理指标。 结合这些指标可以降低对单一指标的依赖。 最后，各阶段评估中使用的基准 API 集合和根本原因 API 需要人工标注。 我们通过应用一致的指导方针，并将标注结果与参考实现、API 文档和运行时追踪进行交叉验证，以减轻潜在的标注偏差。

paragraphs.en: External Validity. The generalizability of our findings is limited by the scope of the evaluated tasks, LLMs, and DL libraries. We evaluate 100 model-level DL programming tasks from DeepEval, six open-weight LLMs from two model families, and three DL libraries: TensorFlow, PyTorch, and PaddlePaddle. Although these settings encompass diverse model architectures and library ecosystems, the results may not generalize to other LLMs, DL libraries, or large-scale real-world projects. Moreover, our evaluation focuses on API-related syntactic issues and tensor-shape mismatches. Other failure types, such as numerical instability and training-related issues, lie outside its scope. Evaluations spanning a broader range of DL tasks, LLMs, libraries, real-world projects, and failure scenarios are therefore needed to assess generalizability beyond the studied settings.
paragraphs.zh: 外部效度。 我们的研究结果的可推广性受到所评估任务、大型语言模型（LLM）和深度学习（DL）库范围的限制。 我们评估了来自 DeepEval 的 100 个模型级 DL 编程任务、来自两个模型家族的六个开放权重 LLM，以及三个 DL 库：TensorFlow、PyTorch 和 PaddlePaddle。 尽管这些设置涵盖了多样的模型架构和库生态系统，但研究结果可能无法推广到其他 LLM、DL 库或大规模的真实世界项目。 此外，我们的评估重点关注与 API 相关的语法问题和张量形状不匹配的问题。 其他类型的失败，例如数值不稳定性和训练相关的问题，则超出了本研究的范围。 因此，为了评估超出当前研究设置的可推广性，有必要开展涵盖更广泛 DL 任务、LLM、库、真实世界项目和失败场景的评估。

paragraphs.en: DL programs define model architectures by composing library-specific APIs into computation graphs, in which tensors are propagated and transformed across operations ( , 2022 ; , 2023 ) . Prior studies have consequently focused on two aspects: common bugs in DL programs and the constraints governing API usage and tensor transformations.

paragraphs.en: Liang et al. ( Liang et al., 2022 ) studied 64 real-world bugs in TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Keras programs and identified API misuse, tensor-shape mismatch, and type mismatch as common bug categories. Yang et al. ( Yang et al., 2024 ) further found that DL API misuses differ from those of general-purpose APIs, frequently involving incorrect parameter types and missing API calls. More recently, Ma et al. ( Ma et al., 2026 ) evaluated LLM-generated DL programs and reported frequent API hallucinations and tensor-shape mismatches. The latter accounted for an average of 77.34% of execution failures. Together, these findings show that reliable DL code generation requires correct API usage and consistent tensor shapes across operations.

paragraphs.en: Beyond characterizing DL program bugs, recent studies have examined the ability of LLMs to extract and reason about API constraints. Xie et al. ( Xie et al., 2025 ) evaluated LLMs for extracting formal specifications from comments and API documentation across TensorFlow, PyTorch, and MXNet. They considered data-type, structural, shape, and valid-value specifications. Their failure analysis identified missing domain knowledge as a major source of extraction errors. Focusing on numerical constraints in PyTorch and NumPy APIs, Deng et al. ( Deng et al., 2024 ) further showed that LLM performance degrades when handling uncommon inputs and complex numerical relationships in APIs such as Conv2d , reshape , and Fold . This finding indicates that LLMs have limited robustness in reasoning about implicit numerical and shape constraints. Together, these observations motivate the use of explicit API knowledge and tensor-shape information when repairing DL programs.
paragraphs.zh: 除了对深度学习程序的错误进行描述外，近期的研究还探讨了大型语言模型提取和推理 API 约束的能力。Xie 等人 （Xie 等人，2025）评估了大型语言模型从 TensorFlow、PyTorch 和 MXNet 的注释及 API 文档中提取形式化规范的能力。 他们考虑了数据类型、结构、形状和有效值方面的规范。 他们的失败分析指出，缺乏领域知识是提取错误的一个主要来源。 Deng 等人专注于 PyTorch 和 NumPy API 中的数值约束。 （Deng 等人，2024）进一步表明，在处理不常见的输入以及 Conv2d、reshape 和 Fold 等 API 中的复杂数值关系时，大型语言模型的性能会下降。 这一发现表明，大型语言模型在推理隐式数值和形状约束方面的鲁棒性有限。 综合来看，这些观察结果促使我们在修复深度学习程序时使用显式的 API 知识和张量形状信息。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves code generation by incorporating external knowledge into the generation context ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . Based on the retrieved knowledge source, existing approaches can be broadly divided into API documentation retrieval and relevant code retrieval.
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将外部知识整合到生成语境中，从而改进代码生成（Jiang 等，2026；Wang 等，2025；Yang 等，2025）。 根据所检索的知识来源，现有方法可大致分为 API 文档检索和相關代码检索。

sents.en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves code generation by incorporating external knowledge into the generation context ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将外部知识整合到生成语境中，从而改进代码生成（Jiang 等，2026；Wang 等，2025；Yang 等，2025）。

sents.en: Based on the retrieved knowledge source, existing approaches can be broadly divided into API documentation retrieval and relevant code retrieval.
sents.zh: 根据所检索的知识来源，现有方法可大致分为 API 文档检索和相關代码检索。

paragraphs.en: API documentation provides explicit knowledge of API functionality, signatures, parameters, and usage. Chen et al. ( Chen et al., 2025 ) showed that documentation retrieval improves code generation, particularly for less commonly used libraries. Zhou et al. ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) proposed DocPrompting, which retrieves relevant documentation using sparse and dense retrieval. Jain et al. ( Jain et al., 2025 ) showed that documentation augmentation can reduce low-frequency API hallucinations and proposed DAG++, which selectively retrieves documentation based on API existence and model confidence. These studies establish the value of API documentation for grounding code generation, but do not explicitly address the gap between high-level task requirements and the fine-grained APIs required for DL implementation. DeepGroundRepair addresses this gap by reasoning about task-relevant APIs before retrieval and routing candidates according to API existence.
paragraphs.zh: API 文档提供了关于 API 功能、签名、参数和用法的明确知识。Chen 等人 ( Chen 等人，2025 ) 的研究表明，文档检索能够提升代码生成效果，尤其是对那些使用频率较低的库而言。Zhou 等人 ( Zhou 等人，2023 ) 提出了 DocPrompting 方法，该方法通过稀疏检索和密集检索来查找相关文档。Jain 等人 ( Jain 等人，2025 ) 的研究表明，文档增强能够减少低频 API 的幻觉问题，并提出了 DAG++ 方法，该方法会根据 API 是否存在以及模型置信度来选择性地检索文档。 这些研究确立了 API 文档在代码生成中提供依据的价值，但并未明确解决高层任务需求与深度学习实现所需精细 API 之间的差距。 DeepGroundRepair 通过在执行检索前对任务相关的 API 进行推理，并根据 API 是否存在来路由候选项，从而弥合了这一差距。

paragraphs.en: Another line of work retrieves relevant code or repository context to provide implementation patterns. Gu et al. ( Gu et al., 2025 ) showed that relevant file context and invoked-API information improve repository-level code generation, whereas irrelevant context can degrade performance. Pan et al. ( Pan et al., 2025 ) combined sparse and dense code retrieval with statically extracted type context, while Li et al. ( Li et al., 2024 ) retrieved similar programs as in-context examples and generated intermediate artifacts to clarify requirements. These approaches primarily retrieve implementation context and reusable code patterns to guide generation. In contrast, DeepGroundRepair retrieves library-specific API specifications to ground API usage during generation and support tensor-shape reasoning during repair.
paragraphs.zh: 另一类方法会检索相关的代码或仓库上下文，以提供实现模式。Gu 等人 （Gu 等人，2025）指出，相关的文件上下文和调用的 API 信息能够提升仓库级别的代码生成效果，而不相关的上下文则可能降低性能。Pan 等人 （Pan 等人，2025）将稀疏和密集的代码检索与静态提取的类型上下文相结合，而 Li 等人 （Li 等人，2024）则检索相似程序作为上下文内的示例，并生成中间产物以明确需求。 这些方法主要通过检索实现上下文和可重用的代码模式来指导生成过程。 相比之下，DeepGroundRepair 会检索特定库的 API 规范，以便在生成过程中为 API 的使用提供依据，并在修复时支持张量形状的推理。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches to repairing LLM-generated code can be broadly divided into training-based and feedback-guided methods. The former learn repair behavior through model optimization, whereas the latter use program feedback to guide repair at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 现有修复大型语言模型生成代码的方法大致可分为基于训练和基于反馈引导两类。 前者通过模型优化学习修复行为，而后者则在推理阶段利用程序反馈来指导修复。

sents.en: Existing approaches to repairing LLM-generated code can be broadly divided into training-based and feedback-guided methods.
sents.zh: 现有修复大型语言模型生成代码的方法大致可分为基于训练和基于反馈引导两类。

sents.en: The former learn repair behavior through model optimization, whereas the latter use program feedback to guide repair at inference time.
sents.zh: 前者通过模型优化学习修复行为，而后者则在推理阶段利用程序反馈来指导修复。

paragraphs.en: One line of work enhances code-repair capabilities through task-specific training on buggy programs and their corrected versions. Ding et al. ( Ding et al., 2024 ) proposed CYCLE, which constructs refinement examples from model-generated faulty code, test feedback, and canonical solutions for iterative self-refinement. Jiang et al. ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) proposed LEDEX, which learns from explanation and refinement trajectories validated through execution, using supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. Huang et al. ( Huang et al., 2023 ) studied how code representations, fault-localization markers, and patch-generation strategies affect fine-tuned program repair. These approaches improve repair performance through dedicated training, whereas DeepGroundRepair performs repair at inference time without model updates.
paragraphs.zh: 一种方法通过针对含错程序及其修正版本的任务特定训练，增强了代码修复能力。Ding 等人 （Ding 等人，2024）提出了 CYCLE，该方法从模型生成的错误代码、测试反馈和标准解决方案中构建优化示例，以实现迭代自我优化。Jiang 等人 （Jiang 等人，2024）提出了 LEDEX，该方法通过执行验证的解释和优化轨迹进行学习，并采用监督微调与强化学习。Huang 等人 （Huang 等人，2023）研究了代码表示、故障定位标记和补丁生成策略如何影响经过微调的程序修复效果。 这些方法通过专门训练来提升修复性能，而 DeepGroundRepair 则无需更新模型，在推理阶段直接执行修复。

paragraphs.en: Another line of work uses behavioral information from generated programs to guide post-generation refinement. Chen et al. ( Chen et al., 2023 ) proposed Self-Debugging, which prompts an LLM to iteratively inspect and revise its code using test results or self-generated explanations. Zhang et al. ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) proposed Self-Edit, which summarizes failures observed from example tests as fault-aware comments for a separately trained code editor to revise the program. Shi et al. ( Shi et al., 2024 ) proposed MGDebugger, which structures repair according to program granularity by decomposing a program into hierarchical subfunctions, deriving local tests, and recursively repairing them from lower to higher levels. These methods demonstrate the effectiveness of program feedback for code repair. However, for DL programs, generic failure feedback provides limited guidance for identifying the upstream API configurations and tensor-shape dependencies underlying DL-specific failures. DeepGroundRepair instead combines root-cause localization with explicit tensor-shape guidance for parameter-level repair.
paragraphs.zh: 另一类方法利用生成程序中的行为信息来指导生成后的优化。Chen 等人 （Chen 等人，2023）提出了自我调试（Self-Debugging），该方法通过测试结果或自生成的解释，引导大型语言模型迭代检查并修改其代码。Zhang 等人 （Zhang 等人，2023）提出了自我编辑（Self-Edit），该方法将示例测试中观察到的失败情况总结为故障相关的注释，供单独训练的代码编辑器用于修改程序。Shi 等人 （Shi 等人，2024）提出了 MGDebugger，该方法通过将程序分解为分层子函数、推导出局部测试，并从底层到高层递归修复，从而按照程序粒度组织修复过程。 这些方法证明了程序反馈在代码修复中的有效性。 然而，对于深度学习程序而言，通用的失败反馈在识别导致深度学习特定故障的上游 API 配置和张量形状依赖方面提供的指导有限。 DeepGroundRepair 则将根本原因定位与明确的张量形状指导相结合，以实现参数级别的修复。

sents.zh: 然而，对于深度学习程序而言，通用的失败反馈在识别导致深度学习特定故障的上游 API 配置和张量形状依赖方面提供的指导有限。

sents.en: DeepGroundRepair instead combines root-cause localization with explicit tensor-shape guidance for parameter-level repair.
sents.zh: DeepGroundRepair 则将根本原因定位与明确的张量形状指导相结合，以实现参数级别的修复。

paragraphs.en: This paper presents DeepGroundRepair , a three-stage framework for improving the syntactic correctness and runtime executability of LLM-generated DL programs. It targets API-level syntactic issues arising during code generation and tensor-shape mismatches that cause runtime failures. The framework progressively narrows the generation and repair spaces by retrieving task-relevant DL API knowledge, localizing the root-cause APIs of shape mismatches through static and dynamic analysis, and inferring shape-consistent API parameters from runtime tensor shapes.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 DeepGroundRepair，一个三阶段框架，用于提升 LLM 生成的深度学习程序的语法正确性和运行时可执行性。 该框架针对代码生成过程中出现的 API 级语法问题以及导致运行时故障的张量形状不匹配问题。 该框架通过检索任务相关的深度学习 API 知识、利用静态和动态分析定位形状不匹配的根源 API，以及根据运行时张量形状推断形状一致的 API 参数，逐步缩小生成与修复空间。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate DeepGroundRepair on DeepEval using six open-weight LLMs across TensorFlow, PyTorch, and PaddlePaddle. Across comparisons with the four baselines, DeepGroundRepair substantially improves CER , achieving an average relative gain of 85.3%. It also reduces API hallucinations and API parameter misuses by 2.14 and 3.26 issues per 10 program files on average, respectively. For repaired programs, it improves SCR by an average of 18.1% relative to the two self-debugging baselines. Together, these findings demonstrate the effectiveness of the generation–localization–repair design of DeepGroundRepair in improving the reliability of LLM-generated DL programs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 TensorFlow、PyTorch 和 PaddlePaddle 平台上，使用六种开源大语言模型（LLM）对 DeepGroundRepair 在 DeepEval 上的性能进行了评估。 在与四种基线方法的对比中，DeepGroundRepair 显著提升了 CER，平均相对增益达到 85.3%。 它还将 API 幻觉和 API 参数误用的问题数量分别平均减少了每 10 个程序文件 2.14 和 3.26 个。 对于修复后的程序，与两种自我调试基线方法相比，它将 SCR 平均提升了 18.1%。 综合来看，这些研究结果证明了 DeepGroundRepair 的“生成–定位–修复”设计在提升大语言模型生成的深度学习程序可靠性方面的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Future work will extend this generation–localization–repair paradigm to provide proactive and comprehensive support for DL program generation and repair. Integrating DL-specific constraints and lightweight verification into the generation process could help prevent failures before post-generation repair is required. Advanced program analyses could handle complex tensor flows. Adaptive multi-step repair strategies could address programs containing multiple interacting faults. Finally, we plan to expand diagnosis and repair beyond API-level issues and tensor-shape mismatches. Potential targets include dtype and device incompatibilities, numerical instability, and failures during training and deployment. Addressing these failures would provide broader support across the DL software lifecycle.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作将把这种生成–定位–修复范式扩展开来，为深度学习程序的生成与修复提供主动且全面的支持。 在生成过程中整合深度学习特定的约束条件和轻量级验证，有助于在需要事后修复之前防止故障发生。 高级程序分析能够处理复杂的张量流。 自适应的多步骤修复策略可以解决包含多个相互作用的故障的程序。 最后，我们计划将诊断和修复的范围扩展到 API 级别的问题和张量形状不匹配之外。 潜在的目标包括数据类型的兼容性问题、设备不兼容、数值不稳定以及在训练和部署过程中出现的故障。 解决这些故障将为整个深度学习软件生命周期提供更广泛的支持。
